plugin.name: HQPlayerBridge
plugin.title: HQPlayer Bridge
plugin.desc: Presents each HQPlayer instance as a native Lyrion player over HQPlayer's own control API - no UPnP bridge and no helper in the playback path; HQPlayer fetches the stream straight from Lyrion, which still converts the formats HQPlayer cannot decode
plugin.creator: CrystalGipsy
